evals.prompt: Review the comment changes in evals/files/comment-noise.py. Which comments should stay, change, or be removed?
evals.expected_output: Rejects comments that restate code, recommends semantic comments only where they explain non-obvious why, and treats uncommented complex code as a smell rather than a quota.
expectations: Rejects comments that restate nearby code
Recommends comments that explain external constraints, invariants, tradeoffs, or what would break
Does not introduce a comment quota for visual spacing

evals.prompt: Review the proposed extraction in evals/files/vue-coincidental-duplication.md. Should these two Vue components be deduplicated?
evals.expected_output: Avoids premature deduplication of coincidental markup and only extracts duplicated decisions or reusable domain transformations.
expectations: Distinguishes coincidental markup similarity from duplicated decisions
Avoids creating a premature shared component or config abstraction
Only extracts reusable domain transformations if a real shared rule exists

evals.prompt: Fix the Ruff FBT issue in evals/files/positional-boolean-report.py and state the verification command you would run.
evals.expected_output: Uses deterministic Ruff FBT guidance, makes the boolean keyword-only or replaces it with an explicit mode, and verifies with the relevant just lint recipe.
expectations: Uses Ruff FBT as the deterministic signal
Replaces the positional boolean with a keyword-only boolean or explicit mode
Verifies with the relevant lint command instead of relying only on review
